items.title: Show HN: See how much revenue declined cards cost your SaaS
items.contentSnippet:
I made a tool to show how much revenue declined cards are costing your SaaS.
You make a read-only Stripe key, and it totals every subscription invoice from the last 90 days that was attempted, failed, and never paid. Plus what Stripe's retries already recovered.
Key is used once and never stored.

items.title: Show HN: Code Counter Machine a modern analysis of AI driven development costs
items.contentSnippet:
I worked a lot with cloc, sloc and scc and used them in various prohects. But with AI driven development some of the models COCOMO I and II might not be applicable.
So built a new cli ccm short for code counter machine with new calculation model which estimate the new AI driven development costs. The formula, logic and the estimates used are there in the docs.
Documentation: https://insanai.github.io/ccm/

items.title: Show HN: Find overlapping Rust tests with mutation testing
items.contentSnippet:
To tackle the ever-increasing number of tests, I built cargo-test-prune.
The idea behind it is to use cargo-mutants to generate mutants, and then solve the set cover problem for those mutants to suggest which tests can be eliminated.
(use a greedy algorithm to cover the detected mutants with fewer tests)
I came up with this as a countermeasure against the monotonically increasing tests that tend to accumulate, especially when coding with AI.
In fact, this very repository was also written using A
